description: The HP-82 Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) serves the Balh sub-division in the Mandi district of Himachal Pradesh. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits specifically for the Balh area, which is a significant commercial hub centered around Ner Chowk. The office operates under the administrative control of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Balh.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Balh, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
